t: Add spoke innovation discovery to gardener — detect local WAI patterns worth sharing across the fleet
perceive: 1. Read hub/.claude/agents/ozi-gardener.md — current Step 2 (per-spoke work loop). 2. Read the historian advisor pattern at WAI-Spoke/advisors/historian/ — how it detects patterns. 3. Check what spoke-specific innovations look like: custom hooks in .claude/hooks/, custom skills in WAI-Spoke/skills/ not in template, custom agents in .claude/agents/.
execute: 1. Add Step 2.5 to ozi-gardener.md (after work loop, before historian): Innovation Scan. 2. For each spoke, compare its .claude/ and WAI-Spoke/skills/ against the framework template. Items IN the spoke but NOT in the template are potential innovations. 3. For each innovation found: check if it has been used (referenced in recent session tracks or invoked in last 10 sessions). 4. If used innovation found: create a signal lug describing the pattern, route to hub for framework consideration. 5. Log innovations found to the per-spoke execution log.
verify: 1. Spoke with a custom hook not in template — gardener log shows 'Innovation found: {hook_name}'. 2. Spoke with unused custom skill — skipped (no signal). 3. Signal created for validated innovation routes to WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/.
acceptance_criteria: ozi-gardener.md includes an Innovation Scan step after the work loop
Custom hooks, skills, and agents not in framework template are detected per spoke
Only innovations with evidence of use (referenced in recent sessions) generate signals
Signal lugs for discovered innovations route to WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Add innovation discovery to the gardener — detect spoke-specific patterns worth sharing, supersedes epic-check-spokes-skill
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not implementing the innovations — just discovering and signaling them for framework consideration
